thread:
nico: dropping a small proposal: "tidy inline controls" — attach compact Stop / Regen buttons to each streaming reply plus a tiny token glance under the timestamp. figma: https://figma.redwood/playground/tidy-inline

anya: Love locality. Less context switching is big. Recommend hit targets >=44px and label buttons for SR users.

rohan: Runtime constraints: Stop must cancel inflight and persist partial text. Regen should create a new response_id. Include response_id in events.

gwen: A11y: use aria-live=\"polite\" on the stream region, buttons with aria-labels ("Stop response", "Regenerate response"), and announce chunk completions not every token. Also honour prefers-reduced-motion.

nico: microcopy idea for token glance: "~24 tokens  " (muted) — keep currency optional. Show delta on regen like "+4 tokens" in green.

anya: For prompt library access, prefer a quick-palette (Cmd+K) and a slide-over for browsing. If inserting while stream active, auto-pause rendering and show toast: "Prompt inserted  Stream paused."

rohan: Dev action: ensure stop flushes KV cache writes and emits playground.stream.stop with response_id + stream_index. Regen emits playground.stream.regen with token_delta.

ux-bot: Analytics events suggested: playground.ui.stream.stop, playground.ui.stream.regen, playground.ui.token.peek. Props: response_id, token_estimate, token_delta, user_prefers_reduced_motion.

gwen: Motion CSS snippet:
```css
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .stream-shimmer { animation: none; }
}
```

nico: Action items:
- Design: finalize compact sizes & token glance (nico)
- Dev: stop/regenerate semantics + analytics (rohan)
- A11y: aria-live & announcement strategy (gwen)
- Analytics: confirm schema (ux-bot)
I'll file UI-PL-10021 and tag eng if no objections. :thumbsup:
